title: Son Goku - Kame Hame Ha [Original]
credit: Japanese Dragon Ball performance; excerpt shared by Carlos on TonosFrikis (2014-06-05).
separation: Demucs htdemucs --two-stems=vocals; voice isolated from the original mixed recording. Some residual effects may remain in the learned vocal stem.
adaptation: Continuous dramatic charge, followed by a separately triggered release. Natural vowels retained; pitch-preserving slowdown, EQ/compression and edge fades. Charge delivery has the same pace in both forms. Energy is supplied by a separate looping DBZ effect, not the voice file.
